scripts.dev:docs: pnpm run bundle && concurrently "pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run build:watch" "pnpm --filter docs run start"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run build && pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run test
scripts.test:watch: pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run build && pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run test:watch
scripts.release:alpha: pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart version prerelease --preid alpha && pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run test && pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart publish --tag alpha
